title: Transition table machine
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape symbols, define a finite Turing machine with $M.k+3$ work tapes and state set $	ext{St}(M)$. Its initial state is the selector state indexed by $0$ with all the associated bits false, and its transition function is the transition rule $	ext{tabTr}(M)$.
